note: What a server sends to put a note in front of a seat.

fields.name: body
fields.note: What the note says. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: heading
fields.note: What the note is headed with, written and padded as above. In everything observed it is the label and the run above is the value it labels.

fields.name: image
fields.note: The name the client loads a picture for the note under, written and padded as above. It is empty in everything observed.

fields.name: what
fields.note: What the client does with the note.

fields.name: tip
fields.note: The name this note answers to, so a later message can name it.
